Name: Secret Woods Warp
Author: jyxdong
Description:
[b][size=4][font=Georgia][u]Description[/u][/font][/size][/b]
Adds a Secret Woods Obelisk to the Wizard's building menu and new crafting item Warp Totem: Secret Woods. Once the Obelisk is built on your farm, interacting with it will instantly teleport you to the Secret Woods.

[u][b][size=4][font=Georgia]Installation instructions[/font][/size][/b][/u]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI[/*]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI[/*]
[/list][b][size=4][font=Georgia][u]Main features[/u][/font][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]New obelisk building available from the Wizard's Tower after retrieving the Wizard's Magic Ink [/*]
[*]Totem available via mail after your first entry to the Secret Woods[/*]
[*]Both teleports you directly to the Secret Woods[/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Georgia][b][u]Note[/u][/b][/font][/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with SVE[/*]
[*]Mandarin version included 含中文[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][font=Georgia][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/font][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]Retrived the Wizard's Magic Ink in-game to unlock the Wizard's building menu[/*]
[/list]
